name: Star of Xil'yeh
summary: The Star of Xil'yeh is a powerful gem said to let its holder speak with beings on other worlds. Gerrig Bonegrip seeks it among three relics in Ironforge.

sections.title: A Relic Sought
sections.body: In Ironforge, Gerrig Bonegrip asks for the Star of Xil'yeh as one of three relics he needs. He seeks the items to trade for Yagyin's Digest, a book tied to the beginning of a new chapter for his order.

faq.q: What does the Star of Xil'yeh do?
faq.answer: The Star of Xil'yeh is said to let its holder speak with beings on other worlds.

faq.q: Why does Gerrig Bonegrip want the Star?
faq.answer: Gerrig needs the Star of Xil'yeh alongside the Hand of Dagun and the Legacy Heart. He seeks the three relics in exchange for Yagyin's Digest.

faq.q: Where can the Star be found?
faq.answer: Grel'borg the Miser in the Alterac Mountains has the Star of Xil'yeh.
Yagyin's Digest is a book Gerrig Bonegrip offers in exchange for three relics. He believes it may help begin a new chapter for his order.

faq.q: What are the other relics Gerrig seeks?
faq.answer: Along with the Star of Xil'yeh, Gerrig asks for the Hand of Dagun and the Legacy Heart.

angles.text: As an Alliance adventurer, you may carry this relic to Gerrig Bonegrip in Ironforge, where he seeks it for his order.

attribution: The Star, the Hand and the Heart (Alliance)
